title: UCB for Large-Scale Pure Exploration: Beyond Sub-Gaussianity
abstract: arXiv:2511.22273v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Selecting the best alternative from a finite set is the central objective of ranking and selection (R&S) and best arm identification (BAI). Traditional R&S or BAI approaches have predominantly relied on Gaussian or sub-Gaussian assumptions on the performance distributions of all alternatives, which limit their applicability to non-sub-Gaussian---especially heavy-tailed---problems. The need to move beyond sub-Gaussianity may become even more critical in large-scale problems, which tend to be especially sensitive to distributional specifications. In this paper, motivated by the widespread use of upper confidence bound (UCB) algorithms in sequential decision making, we investigate their performance in large-scale, non-sub-Gaussian R&S settings. translated_title: 大规模纯探索的UCB算法：超越次高斯性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.22273v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：从有限集合中选择最佳备选方案是排序与选择（R&S）和最佳臂识别（BAI）的核心目标。传统的R&S或BAI方法主要依赖于所有备选方案性能分布的高斯或次高斯假设，这限制了它们对非次高斯——特别是重尾——问题的适用性。在大规模问题中，超越次高斯性的需求可能变得更加关键，因为这类问题往往对分布假设特别敏感。本文中，受上置信界（UCB）算法在序贯决策中广泛应用的启发，我们研究了它们在大规模、非次高斯R&S设置中的性能。我们考虑了最简单的UCB算法类别，其中每个备选方案的UCB值定义为样本均值加上一个仅取决于其自身样本大小的探索奖励。
tldr: 本文研究了UCB算法在大规模非次高斯（尤其是重尾）排序与选择问题中的性能，并超越了传统的次高斯假设，展示了其在广泛分布下的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the performance of UCB algorithms in large-scale non-sub-Gaussian (especially heavy-tailed) ranking and selection problems, moving beyond sub-Gaussian assumptions to demonstrate their applicability under broad distributions.
